context: Tests whether the agent produces an ADR that passes the E.C.A.D.R. quality self-check: explicit problem statement, comprehensive options analysis with at least two alternatives (each with pros, cons, and rejection reasons), active-voice decision, documented consequences split into positive/negative/neutral, and decision drivers written as a prioritized list. Also tests correct file placement for a first ADR.

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section begins with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural active construction (not passive voice, not 'The team decided')

checklist.name: Decision drivers as a list
checklist.description: The Decision Drivers section contains a bullet or numbered list of drivers (not a prose paragraph)

checklist.name: Explicit problem statement in Context
checklist.description: The Context section clearly identifies the specific problem being solved — not just background, but a statement of what is wrong or what gap exists

checklist.name: At least two alternatives listed
checklist.description: The Alternatives Considered section contains at least two distinct options

checklist.name: Each alternative has explicit pros and cons
checklist.description: Every alternative in the Alternatives Considered section lists at least one pro and at least one con

checklist.name: Each alternative has rejection reason
checklist.description: Every alternative includes an explicit reason why it was rejected (not chosen)

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections — all three present with content

checklist.name: Filename starts with 0001
checklist.description: The ADR filename begins with 0001 (four zero-padded digits), reflecting this is the first ADR in the project

checklist.name: Lowercase hyphenated slug
checklist.description: The ADR filename uses a lowercase, hyphenated slug after the sequence number (e.g. 0001-use-zustand-for-state-management.md)

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED in frontmatter
checklist.description: The ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED or DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors field in frontmatter
checklist.description: The ADR has an authors field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The ADR does not contain unfilled template markers such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar placeholder strings
